title: Retry-record acknowledgement fences run on the real clock even in scripted-clock fixtures
outcome: Decide and implement whether a retry record's durable-acknowledgement fence (src/engram_retry_schedule.rs ~:295-300, requested through request_engram_abort_acknowledgement_locked) should use the state's budget clock, so that fixtures on a scripted clock depend on that one clock alone. Today the fence deliberately uses the real clock ("nobody waits on it on the scripted one"). A writer delayed beyond the fence's 20 real seconds lets it expire: the test's ticks then request a fresh acknowledgement instead of reaching dispatch, so a scripted-clock test's outcome can change with real elapsed time. This affects every admission and abort retry test, not only the prepared-begin ones. The fix either moves the fence to the budget clock (no production change, since that clock is real in production) or states, in docs/test.md, why the real clock is required there.
acceptance: C1 (fail-first, unbound): At base (the stacked base, w-cfcf10b68c9b's frozen tree a156d01e988c214899a4ddc6aaa3c2fc32a15c63ee16f33028c023e97611671a), a scripted-clock test withholds the writer's acknowledgement of a parked retry record and advances ONLY the scripted budget clock past ENGRAM_ABORT_SETTLEMENT_FENCE: the retry step still reports Wait (the same fence kept, no re-request) because the fence is measured on the real clock. A holder note cites the host-recorded failed check, its log path and sha256.

C2: The retry-record acknowledgement fence's deadline and its poll use the state's EngramBudgetClock for abort, admission and bind retries; production is unchanged (the Real clock reads Instant::now()). Scripted-clock tests show the fence still pending just before its deadline and expiring exactly at it (a fresh acknowledgement request), with its outcome never depending on real elapsed time; a late acknowledgement resolved at or after the deadline is a Deadline, as for every scripted fence.

C3: Test fixtures that script a dispatch's own admission fences (AcknowledgingWriter and its barrier in src/tests/engram_begin_unknown_recovery.rs, and any other writer fixture that distinguishes fences by clock) tell a dispatch fence from a retry-record acknowledgement fence by something other than the fence's clock, and every existing abort, admission, bind, begin-unknown, begin-replay, begin-boot and begin-preparation retry test passes with its assertions unchanged.
C4: No sleep, polling, watchdog, new timer or enlarged timeout; ENGRAM_ABORT_SETTLEMENT_FENCE keeps its value.
C5: docs/test.md or the engram-host-adapter feature doc states that retry-record acknowledgement fences are measured on the budget clock.
C6: The full gate passes on the exact reviewed tree.
C7: The review pair has no outstanding Medium or higher, and an acceptance evaluation is made by an evaluator that never held the item.
